```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
dvf <- read.csv2("dvf.csv", sep = ";")
```

```{r}
summary(dvf)

```

```{r}
mutations <- dvf |>
  distinct(libnatmut) #6 types de mutations
  
mut_par_an <- dvf |> 
  count(anneemut, name = "nb_mutations")

ggplot(mut_par_an, aes(x = factor(anneemut), y = nb_mutations)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = format(nb_mutations, big.mark = " ")),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = " "),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(title = "Nombre de mutations par année",
       x = "Année de mutation",
       y = "Nombre de mutations") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
mut_par_an_type <- dvf |>
  count(anneemut, libnatmut, name = "nb_mutations")

ggplot(mut_par_an_type, aes(x = factor(anneemut), y = nb_mutations)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  facet_wrap(~ libnatmut, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = " "),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(title = "Nombre de mutations par année et par nature de mutation",
       x = "Année de mutation",
       y = "Nombre de mutations") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
```{r}
mut_par_dep <- dvf |> 
  count(coddep, name = "nb_mutations")

ggplot(mut_par_dep, aes(x = factor(coddep), y = nb_mutations)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = format(nb_mutations, big.mark = " ")),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = " "),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(title = "Nombre de mutations par département",
       x = "Département",
       y = "Nombre de mutations") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
mut_par_dep_type <- dvf |>
  count(coddep, libnatmut, name = "nb_mutations")

ggplot(mut_par_dep_type, aes(x = factor(coddep), y = nb_mutations)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  facet_wrap(~ libnatmut, scales = "free_y", axes = "all_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = " "),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(title = "Nombre de mutations par département et par nature de mutation",
       x = "Département",
       y = "Nombre de mutations") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
dvf |>
  summarise(
    nb_mutations      = n(),
    nb_multi_communes = sum(nbcomm > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    part_multi        = nb_multi_communes/nb_mutations*100
  )

```
3 349 mutations (soit ~0.38% des mutations) sont des mutations qui concernent des bâtiments à cheval sur plusieurs communes
